design_rule: Pareto: a small equal-weight set of transparent funding/conditions inputs; no parameter, horizon or source search after this contract is frozen.
availability_rule: Observation month t becomes eligible at calendar month-end t+1. This makes the 2026-06 candidate directly comparable with the legacy Funding reading available 2026-07-31.

components.source: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago via FRED
components.economic_role: broad financial conditions adjusted for prevailing economic conditions

components.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Kim-Wright term-premium model, via FRED
Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System H.4.1 via FRED
components.monthly_transform: last observation in calendar month, then 3-month percent change

standardization.direction: all component z-scores are signed so positive means more supportive funding/conditions
standardization.composite: equal-weight arithmetic mean of four signed component z-scores

diagnostics_not_in_score: SOFR minus IORB funding spread may be shown prospectively but is excluded from the score because the unified IORB history begins only in 2021.
Treasury plumbing may be added only in a future versioned candidate if it materially improves the decision gate.

fixed_initial_gates.legacy_current_direction: The latest candidate eligible at 2026-07-31 must be compared with the legacy Funding regime RESTRICTIVE; disagreement is reported, never tuned away.
fixed_initial_gates.usefulness: A separate narrow conviction/usefulness gate must pass before promotion. No broad parameter, horizon or asset search is allowed.

legacy_comparator.note: Legacy baseline is preserved only as a comparator. Funding V2 is a separate versioned candidate and is not an attempt to reverse-engineer the missing legacy construction.

guardrails: Funding remains an OVERLAY and cannot overwrite Money Core.
Do not retune weights, windows, thresholds or transforms merely to match the legacy score or pass historical windows.
Current revised FRED history may be used for candidate construction and directional sanity checks, but is not represented as a point-in-time vintage backtest.
Promotion requires reproducible source provenance, a narrow usefulness gate, scheduled refresh and Data Health integration.
